change: First version: a $20 test run that quotes both sides of every bracket off Kalshi prices.
Joins the queue at the best price and goes after the liquidity rewards.
Detects exchange halts and settled markets, and reports its safety limits to the monitor.
Waits for fill confirmation before taking on more risk (added after an exchange data outage).
Combines the fixes above into a single build.
Raises the cap to $40 to cover more markets at the same order size.
Pulls resting quotes as soon as Kalshi moves.
Restarts the bot as a long-running service, with no logic changes.
Uses larger orders and raises the cap to $60.
Adds a soft stop that winds positions down after a losing stretch.
Drops an outside model input, so fair value comes from Kalshi alone.
Quotes only same-day markets, so nothing is held overnight. v13 adds a small safety fix for wind-downs.
